image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a vintage audio cassette tape lying on a solid blue surface. The cassette has a transparent plastic shell with black internal components and spools. A paper label is visible on the face, featuring stylized text that appears to read 'Bozzy Scaggs' or similar, though it is distorted. A small, bright blue portable cassette player (Walkman-style) with a coiled black headphone cable is resting on the bottom-left corner of the cassette, partially obscuring the tape's edge.
